program: median rank fraction, fraction negative and median direction across evaluable nonself members; require >=3 and >=50% for program summaries

celloracle.rank: descending median of per-patient mean absolute delta on reachable cells, equal patient weights; signed delta also reported

exclusion: HGNC 2026-11-18 approved protein-coding members of L/S ribosomal proteins or mitochondrial ribosomal proteins and approved genes on mitochondrial chromosome; RACK1 eukaryotic small-subunit protein included explicitly (UniProt P63244).
shared: top50 for at least 3 of 5 main KOs; count matched controls separately
direction: unadjusted primary; full-library regression then PC1 removal as diagnostics
